physical_blocks.exact_text: Note: Day 1 is the date of first ARV-471/anastrozole dose. Study Day = Assessment Date – Date of Day 1 + 1 for assessment dates on or after date of Day 1. Study Day = Assessment Date – Date of Day 1 for assessment prior to Day 1.
Note: Best percentage change of TL from baseline (indicated with *) is maximum decrease or minimum increase if no decrease being observed.
• Sorting order is by Subject ID, Date of Assessment
